description: This file defines a Python class 'FunctionFilter' that implements a frame filtering mechanism for Pipecat pipelines, allowing frames to pass based on a custom asynchronous filter function, with special handling for system and lifecycle frames.

classes.name: FunctionFilter
classes.description: A frame processor that filters frames using a custom async function, with options to include or exclude system frames and specify processing direction.

methods.name: __init__( self, filter: Callable[[Frame], Awaitable[bool]], direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM, filter_system_frames: bool = False, )
methods.description: Initializes the FunctionFilter with a user-defined asynchronous filter function, filtering direction, and system frame filtering option.

methods.name: _should_passthrough_frame(self, frame, direction)
methods.description: Determines whether a frame should bypass filtering based on direction, frame type, and system frame filtering setting.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes a frame through the filter, deciding whether to pass it on based on filter result and frame properties.
